transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We have a supply-chain finance facility on the table today -- $6,000,000 in supplier invoices from our approved purchasing division. The preliminary proposal assumes we'd finance 90% of eligible invoices, with ordinary supplier recourse and no special funding or screening controls. Before I make a final decision on whether this facility may launch and on what operating terms, I'd like to conduct our standard round-robin review. I'd like to hear from credit risk, legal, and finance operations in turn. Who would like to start?
